credits.title: La luz
credits.overview: A beloved parish priest, Manuel, is ready to leave the clergy and start anew. But when his past threatens to surface, he must face the consequences, beginning a journey that leads him to challenge the institution that protected him.

credits.title: The Beloved
credits.overview: Acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his latest project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. credits.title: Tenéis que verlo
credits.overview: Luis and Ana visit another couple of friends who have just had a baby. What promises to be a quick visit with the sole purpose of meeting the newborn ends up turning into a strange experience that reveals that neither the parents are as fine as they claim, nor the baby as normal as he seems…

credits.title: Alone In The Night
credits.overview: A group of labour lawyers hide in a house when the coup d'état of 23F takes place in Spain. Unsure of what to do, they debate between fleeing the country, staying in hiding or trying to do something to defend Spain's young democracy.

credits.title: How to Be a Modern Man
credits.overview: Andres Cuadrado is an old-fashioned civil servant. Conservative and somewhat macho, he takes his job at the Ministry of Finance very seriously. credits.title: Ama
credits.overview: A portrait of the myth of maternity around the story of Pepa and her daughter, who are evicted from their home and forced to wander for a place to live with no support network.

credits.title: Goodbye
credits.overview: Seville, Spain. Juan Santos, a convicted petty criminal, gets out of jail for a day to celebrate with Triana, his wife, the first communion of their daughter Estrella.

credits.title: Violeta Doesn't Take the Elevator
credits.overview: Violeta is in her early twenties and is doomed to spend the summer in Madrid doing an internship in a publishing house. During those weeks, she will make new friends, and she will make decisions, some good, some bad. And, above all, she will learn that failure is more an art than a tragedy.

credits.title: Parking
credits.overview: Adrian is a young poet who decides to leave Romania and go live to Spain. He wants to change his life, earn some money and learn Spanish. credits.title: When the Angels Sleep
credits.overview: Germán, an honest family man, sees how his whole world wobbles the night when, driving home, accidentally runs over two teenage girls. From that moment, Germán will have to do everything in his power to prevent his life from being destroyed forever.

credits.title: Ama
credits.overview: Pepa, a 31-year-old woman, and her 6-year-old daughter, Leila, find themselves homeless after a major fight that marks the beginning of the story. "AMA" is the journey of these two forces, which travel a complex path, bringing the concept of "love" into sharp focus.

credits.overview: During Holy Week of 59 in the tragicomic social landscape of Franco's Spain, takes place the sentimental chronicle of a nine years old boy: Pablito.
